answer: Honest agents recover stakes plus rewards, while a sybil farm must fund many independent bonds and survive correlated audits; faking N identities costs N times the bond plus slashing risk, making mass deception economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through a stake-and-audit grove: each agent locks a violet-tagged bond in escrow, and peers randomly audit a crystal-seeded sample of its claimed work each epoch. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
